summary.description: Here is an overview of your budget. These summarized numbers show <bold>the last {months} months</bold> as of <bold>{endDate}</bold>. The overall score is based on how well you stayed in your budget, and left wiggle room between your budget and income.

explanations.score0: This period had no financial foundation. Whether you're just starting out or hit a rough patch, there's always room to rebuild.
explanations.score1: This was a very challenging period financially. Even experienced budgeters have tough months—what matters is moving forward.
explanations.score2: Significant struggles this period. Life happens, and sometimes expenses pile up. Focus on small wins as you recover.
explanations.score3: Below average stability this time around. Whether it's unexpected costs or a learning curve, improvement is within reach.
explanations.score4: Getting by this period, but things felt tight. You're keeping your head above water—now let's build some cushion.
explanations.score5: Average financial health for this period. You're managing the basics and moving in a positive direction.
explanations.score6: A solid period overall. You handled most things well, with just a few areas that could use fine-tuning.
explanations.score7: Strong performance this period. You're managing money confidently, with only minor opportunities for optimization.
explanations.score8: Excellent work this period. You're well ahead of typical budgeting challenges and making smart decisions.
explanations.score9: Outstanding financial management this period. You navigated expenses skillfully with very few missteps.
explanations.score10: Exceptional period. You demonstrated mastery over your finances and made consistently smart choices throughout.
